verdict.rationale: ADK documents deployment to managed runtimes: Agent Runtime is a fully managed auto-scaling service for ADK agents, and Cloud Run is reachable via the `adk deploy cloud_run` command. The calling-as-an-API-endpoint half is only implied by docs saying the deployed agent "can be accessed, queried, and used in production"; no endpoint, request format or API reference is shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the HTTP/API endpoint exposed after deployment (routes, request/response schema, auth), independent or hands-on corroboration of calling a deployed agent.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can deploy an agent to a managed runtime and call it as an API endpoint

citations.quote: Agent Runtime is a fully managed auto-scaling service on Google Cloud specifically designed for deploying, managing, and scaling AI agents built with frameworks such as ADK.
Cloud Run is a managed auto-scaling compute platform on Google Cloud that enables you to run your agent as a container-based application.
the next step is to deploy it so it can be accessed, queried, and used in production
